demo.problem: Inventory pressure changes faster than a pricing release cycle.
demo.goal: Introduce demand pricing gradually while watching conversion and revenue guardrails.
demo.payoff: The team can respond to supply in real time without exposing every shopper at once.

pull_request.title: feat: implement demand-based dynamic pricing
pull_request.body: Adjusts product unit prices based on current inventory levels — lower inventory yields a higher demand multiplier, increasing the displayed price to manage supply.
